title: Getting started on the web: shown once per account, reopened from the account menu; the desktop app keeps four steps
steps: S1: run apps/tracy-web/test/onboarding-door.test.mjs with TEST_DATABASE_URL — GET /api/onboarding is null for a new account; POST records once (idempotent); GET then answers that time; no session is 401; a same-site POST is 403 CSRF_ORIGIN.
S2: run packages/ui/tracy-onboard/test/mount.test.mjs — the plugin as dsh loads it into jsdom on the web (no desktop bridge) and in the desktop app (bridge protocol 2).
expect: S2: exit 0, 0 failures; the web shows 3 steps once when the flag is null and POSTs on Done; a closed account sees nothing on load and the Getting started menu row reopens it; the onboarding switch off hides screen and row; the desktop app still shows 4 steps once per device and also POSTs /api/onboarding on close.
fence: Whether the web shows the Getting started screen is the account's (account.onboarding_completed_at), never the browser's; closing it records the account on both surfaces; the web never shows a notifications step it cannot keep; the operator switch hides it everywhere.

tests: a new account has not closed the screen; POST records it once and GET then says when
POST from a customer page on a sibling host is refused by the cross-site guard
the web, an account that never closed it: three steps, "Popular" with no scan, Done on Appearance records the account
the web, an account that closed it: nothing drawn; the account menu row "Getting started" reopens it
the operator switched Getting started off: no screen on first run, no menu row, the menu reopens nothing
the desktop app: still four steps and once per device; a close records the account too, never the account read
